scope: Trustworthy completion, deliberate reuse and offline recovery
practice_checks: Independent pointer with simultaneous human typing
Capture preserves existing destinations and dangling links
Actual reusable KWrite Unicode replace/save with fresh-file check and independent disk-content oracle
Stale file rejected with named failed evidence
Offline inspection and report export with nonexistent compositor endpoint
Child checks cannot verify unchecked parent
Legacy target explicitly revalidated through CLI
Historical revision restore preserves later versions
Hard CPU and held-drag deadlines retain partial evidence and release input
performance_checks: Unchanged exported image is decoded once across stability polls
Export reads bounded to 64 MiB; decoded images/frames bounded to 16 million pixels
Worker checkpoints bounded to 4 MiB, 200 calls/checks and 512 trace events
Record review and HTML embedding have explicit limits
limitations: Updated native plugin is built/tested but not deployed to host; loaded legacy plugin readiness is labelled approximate
Independent keyboard, general GTK/browser compatibility, XWayland and popup grabs remain unsupported/unverified
File checks establish specific assertions, not semantic correctness beyond them
Checkpoint evidence is best effort, never complete input history
Legacy/rebound visual guards require explicit checked revalidation; original files are preserved
